pelka_version: author colon10x_default synchronized export; 371223 cells; do not mix with GEO 370115 export
metadata_contract: Author readDataRobj.m and Figure_1.m define synchronized sampleID, batchID, metatable and annot arrays; common cell IDs independently checked against GEO metadata
specimen_handling: Preserve specimen IDs privately; pool counts across specimens of the same patient only within the identical analysis stratum; each patient gets one summary value
library_handling: Pelka author batchID is checked for patient/specimen/tissue/enrichment/technology consistency; Lee library ID unavailable, not inferred from sample order
threshold_rationale: Coverage-only decision, before reading target expression. At 20 cells worst-case binomial standard error for detection is approximately 0.112 even under cell independence; threshold only flags coarse descriptive support, not precision or biological independence. At least five donors permits an exploratory donor distribution; not a power claim. All smaller groups and all zero target values remain visible separately.
primary_summary: Qualified-patient descriptive median and IQR; fewer than five qualified patients flagged LIMITED_COVERAGE; display all-covered sensitivity separately
detection: Number of cells with raw target UMI > 0 divided by number of cells in patient/type stratum
pseudobulk: Sum raw target UMI and all measured gene UMI within patient/type; CPM=1e6*target_sum/all_gene_sum, no pseudocount, no imputation, no log transform
zero_handling: Retain measured target zero; absent cell type is not a zero-expression patient; nonpositive library size is NOT_EVALUABLE
cross_lineage_composition: NOT_RUN in expression batch; any future sampled-composition analysis must use unsorted only (Lee explicitly Ficoll purified) and never combine with CD45, mixed or unknown enrichment
normal_tumor: Separate descriptive strata; no differential tests or paired effect inference
gene_annotation: Exact source gene symbols; missing or duplicated target rows must stop for review; do not assume no detection
family: NA: descriptive localization only, no P values or BH correction
limitations: Within-type expression does not identify metabolite source or metabolic flux
External cohorts do not validate CAMP metabolite-RNA pairs
No cell treated as independent patient
No original malignant epithelial label upgraded by inference
privacy: Expression summary suppressed for fewer than 3 patients; coverage retained
